text: Between saying and doing lies the sea.
meaning: Plans only cross by actually rowing.

text: No master ever fell from the sky.
meaning: Everyone skilled started out clumsy.

text: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
meaning: Failure is part of the work, not the verdict.

text: Deer do not walk into the mouth of a sleeping lion.
meaning: Opportunities go to those who are up and moving.

text: Fall into a pit, gain in your wit.
meaning: Each stumble leaves you sharper.

text: Nothing will ever be attempted if all possible objections must be first overcome.
meaning: You do not need to feel fully ready.

text: One misfortune teaches more than a thousand pieces of advice.
meaning: Rejections are teachers that actually stick.

text: Grind an iron rod long enough and it becomes a needle.
meaning: Steady daily effort wears down impossible-looking tasks.

text: A person is a person through other people.
meaning: Your network is part of your strength.

text: Among three people walking, one will surely be my teacher.
meaning: Interviewers, peers, rejectors: all can teach you.

text: What you have learned is a handful of earth; what you have not is the world.
origin: Tamil saying, traditionally credited to Avvaiyar
meaning: There is always more to learn; stay curious.

text: The shrimp that falls asleep is carried off by the current.
meaning: Keep moving; the market will not wait for you.

text: When eating the fruit, remember who planted the tree.
meaning: Thank your referrers, then become one.

text: When you must, you can.
meaning: Under pressure, you find more than you expected.

text: The best way out is always through.
origin: Robert Frost, A Servant to Servants
meaning: Skipping the hard part is rarely an option.

text: Regret never comes first.
meaning: Regret only arrives after the chance has passed.

text: The old man lost his horse. Who can say it was misfortune?
meaning: A setback's meaning is rarely clear on day one.

text: Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, I will try again tomorrow.
meaning: Tomorrow's attempt counts as much as today's.

text: The willow does not break under the weight of snow.
meaning: Yield to pressure and the load eventually slides off.

text: Fortune helps those who dare.
meaning: Apply to the stretch role anyway.

text: Whoever strives will find.
meaning: Sustained effort eventually turns something up.

text: He who chases two hares catches neither.
meaning: Pick your target roles and aim.

text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
meaning: Small, light, and quietly still there.

text: Persistent tapping breaks the stone.
meaning: Repeated small knocks eventually open things.

text: Three people together have the wisdom of a sage.
meaning: Ask around; more heads find better routes.

text: Whoever is not taught by their mother will be taught by the world.
meaning: The world teaches what you have not yet learned.

text: Traveller, there is no road; the road is made by walking.
meaning: Path appears only once you start moving.

text: Even a monkey falls from a tree.
meaning: Skill is not immunity from falling.

text: Starting is half the work.
meaning: The hardest part is pressing send.

text: People live in each other's shelter.
meaning: Nobody does this alone; lean on people.

text: If you are in a hurry, go around.
meaning: The longer, surer route often arrives first.

text: One finger cannot crush a louse.
meaning: Some jobs need a second hand; ask for it.

text: Just take it bird by bird.
meaning: Break the overwhelming into the next small task.

text: There is no bad weather, only bad clothes.
meaning: Gear up for what is coming and go anyway.

text: Help is nearer than the door.
meaning: Support may be closer than it feels.

text: You are not required to finish the work, but you are not free to abandon it.
meaning: Keep doing your part without needing the whole result.

text: It is no shame to go back for what you forgot.
meaning: Revisiting feedback and old lessons is not defeat.

text: He who asks is a fool for five minutes; he who never asks is a fool forever.
meaning: Ask for the referral; the awkwardness passes quickly.

text: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
origin: John A. Shedd, Salt from My Attic
meaning: Safe applications get safe results; reach.

text: Beyond the mountains, more mountains.
meaning: Each ridge crossed reveals the next; keep walking.

text: Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
meaning: One twig a day makes a home.

text: The gardener may water a hundred pots; fruit still waits for its season.
meaning: Effort is yours; the timing is not.

text: While I breathe, I hope.
meaning: As long as you are in the game, anything can turn.

text: In the field of observation, chance favours only the prepared mind.
meaning: Luck needs preparation to land on.

text: Never a day without a line.
origin: Pliny the Elder, on the painter Apelles
meaning: Do a little every single day.

text: When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion.
meaning: Many small connections make something strong.

text: The best is the enemy of the good.
meaning: Send the good application now.

text: Measure seven times, cut once.
meaning: Prepare carefully before the interview or offer.

text: When a person says yes, their chi says yes.
meaning: Commit fully and fortune tends to follow.

text: Have the crow's effort, the heron's focus, and the dog's light sleep.
meaning: Be alert, be still, stay ready to wake.
